keyEvents.text: Alphadjo Cisse (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, AC Milan 0, Ferencváros 0.
Substitution, AC Milan. Christian Pulisic replaces Alphadjo Cisse.
Substitution, AC Milan. Mario Gila replaces Sankhoun Diawara.
Substitution, AC Milan. Diego Moreira replaces Yunus Musah.
Second Half begins AC Milan 0, Ferencváros 0.
Koni De Winter (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! AC Milan 0, Ferencváros 1. Lenny Joseph (Ferencváros) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kristoffer Zachariassen.
Substitution, AC Milan. Luka Modric replaces Ardon Jashari.
Goal! AC Milan 0, Ferencváros 2. Lenny Joseph (Ferencváros) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kristoffer Zachariassen following a fast break.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Ádám Madarász replaces Matús Bero.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Bamidele Yusuf replaces Lenny Joseph.
Substitution, AC Milan. Francesco Camarda replaces Davide Bartesaghi.
Bamidele Yusuf (Ferencváros) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Habib Maïga replaces Kristoffer Zachariassen.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Jonathan Levi replaces Veljko Birmancevic.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Daniel Arzani replaces Márius Corbu.
Ádám Nagy (Ferencváros) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
